text: Tired all the time, everything aches, and you barely see the sun?
It might not be your training. It could be your vitamin D.
Vitamin D supports your bones, muscles, and immune system. And many people are low, especially indoors or in winter.
Vitamin K2 is often paired with it, to help put calcium into your bones.
Take it with a meal that has some fat. On blood thinners? Check with your doctor first.
You can start a basic dose, but get a blood test. If you're severely low, you may need a higher dose your doctor prescribes. Save this.
